card.name: Dances of Universal Peace
card.tagline: United States — spiritual practice that employs singing and dancing the sacred phrases of the world's religions
card.profile: The Dances of Universal Peace (DUP) are a spiritual practice that employs singing and dancing the sacred phrases of the world's religions. Their intention is to raise consciousness and promote peace between diverse religions according to one stated goal. The DUP are of North American Sufic origin. They combine chants from many world faiths with dancing, whirling, and a variety of movement with singing.
card.insight: The very first dance took place on 16 March, 1968 in San Francisco, California.
